claims.text: The hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size, architecture, subsampling rate, and window size.
Various combinations of hyperparameters were tested for word2vec, including dimensions ranging from 50 to 1,000 and vocabulary sizes from 30,000 to 3,000,000.
The study aims to determine the optimal combinations of word2vec hyperparameters for both intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation tasks.
